caption:
You track your water, your sleep, your habits. You have more data about your life than ever. And you still don't know why you feel off. The Untracked Page replaces the spreadsheet with three sentences. We're building a guided journal for overthinkers — DM "JOURNAL" for a free sample. Save this.

#journaling #overthinking #mentalhealth #habits #arajournals
hook: you track your habits, your water, your sleep — not how you feel
